proof_boundary: This proves the positive-amplitude logarithmic Fourier-jet representation, Bochner positivity of its difference kernel, the exact leading Turan-current identity, zero-fibre sign, an integer-log common-phase nonpromotion guard, and an exact correction decomposition. It proves no signed joint bound, upper bound on Phi_B, contact exclusion, retained aggregate sign, Xi residual transfer, Q209, cofinal descendant theorem, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or prize-level conclusion.

symbolic_certificate.polar_carrier: Write s_*=sigma+i*tau and polarize the nonzero common factor eta/S_a=omega*|eta/S_a|, |omega|=1. Then w_n=omega*A_n*exp(-i*tau*ell_n), where ell_n=log(n) and A_n=|eta/S_a|*exp[t*ell_n^2/4-sigma*ell_n]>0.
symbolic_certificate.polynomial_functional: For every polynomial P of degree at most four, sum_(n<=B)P(ell_n)w_n=[P(i*partial_z)Z(z)]_(z=tau).
symbolic_certificate.bochner_factorization: For real x_j and complex v_j, sum_(j,k)v_j*conj(v_k)F(x_j-x_k)=sum_(n<=B)A_n*|sum_j v_j*exp(-i*x_j*ell_n)|^2>=0.

leading_current_certificate.shifted_trace: Put u_n=log(a/n)=L_a-ell_n and f(y)=Re[e^(-i*y*L_a)Z(tau-y)]=Re sum_(n<=B)w_n*exp(-i*y*u_n); define g(y) as the imaginary part of the same sum.
leading_current_certificate.leading_observations: At C=1, D=0, s_*'=-i/2, s_*''=0, b=-1/2, b_x=0, and chi_N=-i*u_N/2, the real bulk observations are V=f, Q=A=f'/2, and N=f''/4+(u_x/2)g at y=0.
leading_current_certificate.logarithmic_identity: On every interval where f is nonzero, f*f''-(f')^2=f^2*(log|f|)''. The division-free left side is the primary identity.
leading_current_certificate.zero_fibre: If f(0)=0, then P_bulk^(0)=-(f'(0))^2/4<=0; the u_x*f*g term vanishes without division.

finite_guard_certificate.phase_choice: Take tau=pi/log(2), omega=-1, A_1=1/2, A_2=1. Then exp[-i*tau*log(2)]=exp(-i*pi)=-1, so w_1=-1/2 and w_2=1.
finite_guard_certificate.pi_provenance: The pi in this guard is chosen solely to make a half-turn on the log(2) frequency: tau*log(2)=pi and exp(-i*pi)=-1. It is not an inserted physical constant and it proves only a nonimplication. The separate physical u_x=h^2/(8*pi) is inherited from the certified growing-tail source.
finite_guard_certificate.scope: This exact two-atom example has positive amplitudes, integer logarithmic support, and one common logarithmic phase, but it is not an attained large-q=1 Xi chart. It proves that those abstract properties and Bochner positivity alone cannot sign the leading bulk current.

exact.domain: Use the fixed physical q=1, L>=50 terminal/bulk chart with B=N-M-1 and the correction-free carrier w_n=(eta/S_a)exp[t*log(n)^2/4-s_*log(n)]. The source gives eta/S_a nonzero; no assumption that S_a is positive or real is made.
exact.bochner_boundary: Bochner positivity controls the unweighted phase-difference matrix F(x_j-x_k). It does not control the phase-sum family w_nw_m, the polynomially weighted Hermitian kernel, the endpoint-linear sum, or their joint real projection.
exact.exact_correction_decomposition: Let E=Re sum_(n<=B)L_nw_n and let H_0^+,T_0^+ be the ideal kernels H_0^+(n,m)=-(u_n+u_m)^2/8 and T_0^+(n,m)=-(lambda_n-lambda_m)^2/8-i*u_x/2. Then exactly h^2*Phi_B=E+P_bulk^(0)+R_corr, where R_corr=(1/2)Re sum_(n,m<=B){[H^+-H_0^+]w_nconj(w_m)+[T^+-T_0^+]w_nw_m}.
exact.correction_boundary: Every kernel difference in R_corr vanishes at the ideal specialization, but no quantitative bound on E or R_corr is proved here. They may not be discarded or absorbed into an unnamed error.
exact.sharp_target: Use the actual physical tau, amplitudes A_n, terminal aggregate, and correction coefficients to prove E+P_bulk^(0)+R_corr<=h^2/400, preferably h^2/800. A viable argument must control the phase-sum family jointly with the weighted phase-difference family and endpoint.
exact.proof_boundary: This proves the positive-amplitude logarithmic Fourier-jet representation, Bochner positivity of its difference kernel, the exact leading Turan-current identity, zero-fibre sign, an integer-log common-phase nonpromotion guard, and an exact correction decomposition. It proves no signed joint bound, upper bound on Phi_B, contact exclusion, retained aggregate sign, Xi residual transfer, Q209, cofinal descendant theorem, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or prize-level conclusion.

rows.claim: The reduction uses the certified correction-free physical carrier.
rows.formula: Use the fixed physical q=1, L>=50 terminal/bulk chart with B=N-M-1 and the correction-free carrier w_n=(eta/S_a)exp[t*log(n)^2/4-s_*log(n)]. The source gives eta/S_a nonzero; no assumption that S_a is positive or real is made.
rows.proof_boundary: No sign is imported from the source.

rows.claim: The common carrier factor can be polarized without assuming S_a is real.
rows.formula: Write s_*=sigma+i*tau and polarize the nonzero common factor eta/S_a=omega*|eta/S_a|, |omega|=1. Then w_n=omega*A_n*exp(-i*tau*ell_n), where ell_n=log(n) and A_n=|eta/S_a|*exp[t*ell_n^2/4-sigma*ell_n]>0.
rows.proof_boundary: Only nonvanishing of eta/S_a is used.

rows.claim: All five moments belong to one logarithmic-frequency exponential polynomial.
rows.proof_boundary: The frequencies are the actual ell_n=log(n).

rows.claim: The five complex moments are exactly the first five tau jets.
rows.proof_boundary: This is an identity, not a derivative estimate.

rows.claim: Every degree-at-most-four carrier polynomial is a differential functional of Z.
rows.formula: For every polynomial P of degree at most four, sum_(n<=B)P(ell_n)w_n=[P(i*partial_z)Z(z)]_(z=tau).
rows.proof_boundary: No moment is treated as independent.

rows.claim: The two-carrier families have distinct logarithmic phase geometries.
rows.proof_boundary: The global unit phase cancels only in the ratio family.

rows.claim: The unweighted phase-difference kernel is positive semidefinite.
rows.formula: For real x_j and complex v_j, sum_(j,k)v_j*conj(v_k)F(x_j-x_k)=sum_(n<=B)A_n*|sum_j v_j*exp(-i*x_j*ell_n)|^2>=0.

rows.claim: Bochner positivity does not sign the complete current.
rows.formula: Bochner positivity controls the unweighted phase-difference matrix F(x_j-x_k). It does not control the phase-sum family w_nw_m, the polynomially weighted Hermitian kernel, the endpoint-linear sum, or their joint real projection.
rows.proof_boundary: No transpose or endpoint sign is inferred.

rows.claim: The leading distance moments are derivatives of one real trace.
rows.formula: Put u_n=log(a/n)=L_a-ell_n and f(y)=Re[e^(-i*y*L_a)Z(tau-y)]=Re sum_(n<=B)w_n*exp(-i*y*u_n); define g(y) as the imaginary part of the same sum. For S_r=sum_(n<=B)u_n^r*w_n, f(0)=Re(S_0), f'(0)=Im(S_1), f''(0)=-Re(S_2), and g(0)=Im(S_0).
rows.proof_boundary: The imaginary quadrature g is retained.

rows.claim: The four ideal observations reduce to f, f', f'', and g.
rows.formula: At C=1, D=0, s_*'=-i/2, s_*''=0, b=-1/2, b_x=0, and chi_N=-i*u_N/2, the real bulk observations are V=f, Q=A=f'/2, and N=f''/4+(u_x/2)g at y=0.
rows.proof_boundary: This is only the exact ideal specialization.

rows.claim: The ideal bulk current is a Turan numerator plus one quadrature term.
rows.formula: P_bulk^(0)=V*N-A*Q=[f*f''-(f')^2]/4+(u_x/2)*f*g at y=0. On every interval where f is nonzero, f*f''-(f')^2=f^2*(log|f|)''. The division-free left side is the primary identity.

rows.claim: On the physical zero fibre f(0)=0, the leading bulk current is nonpositive.
rows.formula: If f(0)=0, then P_bulk^(0)=-(f'(0))^2/4<=0; the u_x*f*g term vanishes without division.
rows.proof_boundary: This does not control points where f is nonzero.

rows.claim: Positive amplitudes and common logarithmic phase alone do not give a global sign.
rows.formula: n=1,2; a=4; ell_1=0, ell_2=log(2); u_1=2log(2), u_2=log(2); Take tau=pi/log(2), omega=-1, A_1=1/2, A_2=1. Then exp[-i*tau*log(2)]=exp(-i*pi)=-1, so w_1=-1/2 and w_2=1. P_bulk^(0)=log(2)^2/8>0 for every real u_x
rows.proof_boundary: This exact two-atom example has positive amplitudes, integer logarithmic support, and one common logarithmic phase, but it is not an attained large-q=1 Xi chart. It proves that those abstract properties and Bochner positivity alone cannot sign the leading bulk current.
